hero.tagline: Report a problem. Rally your neighborhood. Make change visible.
hero.subtitle: Turn neighborhood complaints into collaborative City Quests. Gemini AI structures your photo report, neighbors rally to gather evidence, and verified improvements are tracked on an open civic map.
hero.trusted_banner: AI proposes, the backend decides. Every point is verified & idempotent.

report_flow.title: Report a Civic Issue
report_flow.dropzone_prompt: Drag & drop an issue photo here, or browse files
report_flow.dropzone_sample: Or try with a pre-loaded sample photo:
report_flow.privacy_warning: Photo Privacy: EXIF and GPS tags are automatically stripped before analysis. Please avoid capturing faces or vehicle license plates.
report_flow.location_prompt: Select Location on Map or use Geolocation
report_flow.analyzing_prompt: Gemini AI is analyzing visible physical evidence...
report_flow.ai_disclaimer: AI proposes, you decide. Please review and edit the suggested values below.
report_flow.duplicate_alert_desc: We found existing reports within 100 meters filed recently. Backing an existing report helps authorities prioritize faster and prevents duplicate clutter.
report_flow.btn_submit_anyway: This is a Different Issue, Submit Anyway
report_flow.success_desc: Your issue is now logged on the community map. Once verified by community moderators, it will unlock a new City Quest for your neighborhood.

quests.title: City Quest Mode
quests.subtitle: Civic issues aren't just tickets—they are team missions. Join neighborhood squads, gather verifiable progress photos, and make change visible.
quests.safety_notice: Never attempt hazardous repairs. Document and verify from a safe pedestrian distance.

report_detail.no_evidence: No evidence photos submitted yet. Be the first to document progress!
